name: Nemesia Dimon
source:
Nemesia is a noble demon; the only daughter of the Duke of Dimon. She lives in a city in the human world hiding her true identity. She has a pair of wings on her back she usually hides for obvious reasons. 
Nemesia is a bit naive demon girl. Also, she is the protagonist's secret stalker, who's always looking at him from somewhere.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=2784]Getchu[/url].]
